factors: Several distinct architecture, specification-authority and outcome-evidence questions in a sixteen-minute walkthrough
Consequential proposed adaptation of an existing review process
complexity.rationale: The source and proposed interpretation require explicit coverage, counterevidence and a testable comparison. Three separately mapped passages preserve the source roles without claiming video witness.

sourceMap.rationale: Maps the attributed narration to the corresponding analytical passage while preserving machine-ASR and unverified-outcome limits.

sourceCoverage.rationale: Three source moments map context separation, application mapping and the reported drift finding; primary repository records bound technical claims.

supportingArgument.rationale: The Reader grants the value of a specification surviving another reader without the author conversation and of review on costly irreversible features.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Project documentation, machine-ASR presenter accounts, unverified demonstrations and GhostMesh counterhypotheses remain explicitly distinct.

counterargument.rationale: The strongest case for extra review is that one prevented consequential omission can outweigh false-positive and preparation costs.

tradeoffs.rationale: Fresh contexts can lose business constraints or share errors; adjudication and document authority determine the value of more reviewer stages.

falsifiability.rationale: A proposed bounded comparison records valid unique findings, wrong or repeated findings and resolution costs against the actual existing review baseline.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The original judgment is to adapt context separation and assess different failure modes and accountable dispositions before expanding review machinery.

performance.rationale: Project workflow fixtures are distinguished from reduced production-defect claims; no comparative outcome or causal benefit was measured.

economics.rationale: Human reading, rejected findings, model use and correction effort enter the proposed full review cost without invented monetary estimates.

threatGovernance.rationale: Document authority and missing organizational constraints are considered; no security assurance, pilot authority or uncontrolled rollout is inferred.

gaps.rationale: SourceID remains unassigned and global source queue unknown; stable YouTube identity and retained-source hashes qualify limited paraphrase without a closed ReasonPack or listening/visual witness claim.
Exact manuscript source review is accepted. Separate independent rendered review, owner native editorial marker and production decision remain future qualification steps.

decisionRationale: Accept the bounded content for owner review and local integration after independent manuscript review and explicit owner semantic/relationship acceptance. This does not attest rendered UAT, authenticated PR marker or production authorization.
